title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.value: Clearly variable spacing over four measured intervals; the final two intervals are substantially longer than the first two.
fields.basis: Provisional positive peak-to-peak spacing in original PDF 582
fields.reason: Selected pixel gaps: 122 px, 130.5 px, 177 px, 187 px. These describe a short sample, not a validated rhythm classification.

fields.basis: Assumed course speed 25 mm/s; 151 detected lines enclose 150 minor horizontal intervals across 736 pixels in the observed calibration segment.
fields.reason: 4 retained positive peak-to-peak intervals have mean spacing 154.12 px, giving 47.8 bpm. Individual-interval estimates span approximately 39.4–60.3 bpm under the same assumption; this is observed interval variation, not a confidence interval. No numerical speed label or labeled timing duration is verified on this strip. This is interval-derived, not a six-second beat count or a claim of a stable rate.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: The intervening trace contains several small rounded or notched wavelets with variable prominence. Two pre-complex examples are recorded for each selected tall excursion. A broader post-complex hump is also present and is not chosen as P merely by timing. The number and shape of visible low-amplitude features vary, and no unique corresponding P onset is established.

fields.value: Five tall sharp positive spikes, each with a small downward return and a later broader rounded upward deflection. Numerous lower-amplitude irregular undulations are visible between complexes.
fields.basis: New descriptive observation of the original raster, not a source-authored rhythm diagnosis
fields.reason: No diagnostic rhythm label, validated P-wave identity, validated conduction interval or clinical conclusion is assigned. Conditional interval estimates, where present, remain unvalidated. Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.

A mean can conceal changing spacing. No sustained rate or diagnostic rhythm is inferred.

Two nonoverlapping, wave-free upper bands provide matching complete line sequences within 0.5 px. Their adjacent gaps are consistent with the visually evident ~5 px minor grid. Lower-band detections miss lines and are not used.
Low-amplitude baseline undulations and the broad later humps are not counted as additional ventricular complexes.
No discrete P-wave series or absence of P waves is established from these pixels.
